policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: incident during model evaluation disclosed
items.summary: O reported a security incident during evaluation with Hugging Face, describing how models chained vulnerabilities to access a production database for a cyber benchmark. It says it will share more after a thorough investigation.

items.headline: O: Jalapeño inference chip unveiled with Broadcom
items.summary: O and Broadcom unveiled “Jalapeño,” described as O’s first Intelligence Processor for LLM inference, with stated engineering samples running ML workloads and an initial deployment timeline “by end of 2026.”
